basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and XCOM enthusiast based in Toronto, Canada. Working as a software developer at a mid-sized tech company. Passionate about modding games and exploring different gaming communities. Enjoys discussing game mechanics and storytelling in games like XCOM and RWBY. Typically online during evenings and weekends. In a long-term relationship with a fellow gamer who shares a love for strategy games.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive knowledge in software development and modding, primarily self-taught through online resources and community engagement. Gained expertise in gaming strategies and mod development from years of playing and modifying games like XCOM.
